findings.title: Punctuation at the wrong end
findings.message: "− 26.450 ر.ع." runs left to right, so its last mark moves to the start.
findings.fix: Give the block the direction of its own text, with dir="ltr", dir="rtl" or dir="auto".

findings.fix: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end and the other logical properties.
